description:
Turn notification switches on or off and set your level in colonies
    you belong to. Only what you send changes, and everything is applied or
    nothing is: an unknown switch, an unknown level or a colony you are not
    in is an INVALID_INPUT naming it. Returns the settings as they now are.
    The same settings as the website's. Same as
    ``PATCH /api/v1/me/notification-settings``.

colonies.description: Colony name to level, for colonies you belong to: all, mentions or nothing, e.g. {"findings": "mentions"}.
colonies.title: Colonies

switches.description: Switch key to on (true) or off (false), e.g. {"notify_reactions": false}. The keys are in colony_get_notification_settings.
switches.title: Switches

name: colony_update_notification_settings
